author: sonnet
label: seeded-01-01
changes: Added a summary and a short description of how the page and API work today, so a newcomer has context.
Added a Terms section defining replica, job queue, multipart upload, export record and the large-report test.
Added a report_exports table section with columns and the partial unique index that prevents duplicate active exports; the duplicate click returns the existing record.
Rewrote the steps as 8 numbered steps covering the trigger, data, state and failure for each; the POST returns the record and the page polls a latest-export endpoint every 5 seconds.
Spelled out the job: 5,000-row replica batches, one 8 MB buffer per part, multipart key, complete only at the end, then signed link and email, then done.
Made failure handling explicit: abort the upload on each failed attempt, one failure email from on_final_failure only after the last attempt, repeated delivery stops if already done.
Added a failure table, a cleanup note and an Open questions section (timeout, nightly rebuild, expired file shown as done).
Removed the job_id column and the save-job_id step, since nothing uses it (Q14).
Step 4: page says the link was emailed when done and has no download button; retries show plain running (Q11, Q15).
Step 7: stated why email comes before done and that a duplicate email and file replacement can happen on retry (Q12).
Step 8: explained the record stays running during backoff and keeps blocking duplicate clicks, and gave the worst-case time to final failure (Q13).
Failure summary: updated the retry and email rows to match steps 7 and 8.
Open questions: added fresh-link option and the stuck-queued record if the API dies before enqueue.
Step 1: stated that the small path returns 200 text/csv and the large path returns 202 JSON, so the page branches on status code (Q16).
Step 4: added why the first poll after a click always shows the new export (Q17).
Terms and step 8: said the queue itself calls on_final_failure with the payload holding export_id (Q18).
Step 5 and failure table: the job stops if the record is missing, done or failed (Q19).
Step 7: noted the page shows running until the done write, so the email can arrive first (Q20).
Removed the Failure summary table and the Cleanup section; per-step failure lines now carry that content and cleanup is a sentence in step 7.
Moved the bucket lifecycle facts (24-hour upload discard, 7-day deletion) into the multipart term.
Moved the table schema out of the numbered steps into a short paragraph after the terms, and renamed the steps section 'How it runs'.
Gave every step a Failure line, including steps 5 and 6, and merged the repeated worker-death and retry statements into step 8.
Shortened step 4 and the step 7 explanation of email-before-done; dropped the duplicated queue behaviour and on_final_failure payload note from the terms.
Added a short sentence on the page branching and removed repeated wording about records and replica reads.
holes: Q8: What is `send_email` and what does the signed link contain: who can open it and for how long? (author: send_email(user_id, template, params) exists per the brief, but I have not seen its code or templates. I assumed two templates, report_export_ready with the link and report_export_failed; their names are my choice. The signed link is a bearer URL from signed_url, valid 24 hours (the maximum allowed), so anyone holding it can download. It goes only to the requesting user by email.)
